from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

# In obs_0029, lamp base center:
# The pole connects to the base at the center of the base disc.
# Where is the vertical pole?
img29 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0029.png"))
# Pole is between shade and base, e.g. rows 300 to 400:
ys_pole, xs_pole = np.where((img29[300:400, :, 0] > 60) & (img29[300:400, :, 0] < 110) & (img29[300:400, :, 1] > 60) & (img29[300:400, :, 1] < 110))
u_pole = xs_pole.mean()

ys_base, xs_base = np.where((img29[:, :, 0] > 60) & (img29[:, :, 0] < 110) & (img29[:, :, 1] > 60) & (img29[:, :, 1] < 110) & (np.arange(512)[:, None] > 400))
v_base_bot = ys_base.max()
v_base_top = ys_base.min()
print("Base v min, max in obs 29:", v_base_top, v_base_bot)
v_base_center = (v_base_top + v_base_bot) / 2.0
print("Base center (u, v):", u_pole, v_base_center)

def ground_to_world(u, v, X_cam, Y_cam, heading_deg):
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    z_cam = 1.55 * 256.0 / (v - 256.0)
    x_cam = (u - 256.0) * 1.55 / (v - 256.0)
    X_w = X_cam + z_cam * np.sin(theta) + x_cam * np.cos(theta)
    Y_w = Y_cam + z_cam * np.cos(theta) - x_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return X_w, Y_w

print("Base center world:", ground_to_world(u_pole, v_base_center, 0.793, 4.207, 90))
